name: FastAPI for Production Python APIs
certifications: No vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
Python Institute PCAP: Certified Associate Python Programmer (Python foundation)

beginner.summary: For Python developers building their first APIs. Covers FastAPI projects, path and query parameters, Pydantic request and response models, status codes and errors, automatic OpenAPI docs, dependency injection, SQLAlchemy and SQLModel, Alembic migrations, CRUD routers, async endpoints, OAuth2 password flow with JWT, settings, uploads, background tasks, middleware and CORS, testing, calling other APIs with HTTPX, pagination and running in Docker.
prerequisites: Writes Python functions, classes and modules
Understands HTTP and JSON at a basic level
Knows what a database table is
outcomes: Build documented REST APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic
Store data with SQLAlchemy and Alembic
Secure endpoints with OAuth2 and JWT

days.topic: FastAPI Overview and Project Setup
subtopics: What FastAPI is: Starlette, Pydantic and type hints
Where FastAPI fits compared with Flask and Django
Creating a virtual environment with uv or venv
Installing FastAPI and the fastapi CLI
A first endpoint and fastapi dev
Uvicorn and ASGI in simple terms
Calling the API from a browser, curl and HTTPie
days.lab_task: Create a FastAPI project for a library service, write a health endpoint and a hello endpoint with type hints, run it with fastapi dev and call it from the docs page, curl and HTTPie.
days.deliverable: Running project skeleton in a Git repository
objectives: Create and run a FastAPI project

days.topic: Path Operations, Path and Query Parameters
subtopics: Path operation decorators for HTTP methods
Query parameters, defaults and optional values
days.lab_task: Build endpoints to fetch books by ID, list books by genre with an enum, search by title with a length-checked query and page with limit and offset defaults.
checks: Parameters and limits shown in the docs

days.topic: Request Bodies with Pydantic Models
subtopics: Converting models to dicts and JSON
days.lab_task: Define Pydantic models for creating and updating books with constraints, nested author data and examples, and test validation errors from the docs page.
checks: Example bodies shown in the docs

days.topic: Response Models, Status Codes and Errors
subtopics: Status codes for create, update and delete
days.lab_task: Return books through output models that hide internal fields, set correct status codes, raise HTTPException for missing books and add a handler that formats domain errors consistently.
days.deliverable: Endpoints with clean responses and errors
checks: Internal fields never appear in responses

days.topic: Automatic Docs: OpenAPI, Swagger UI and ReDoc
subtopics: How FastAPI builds the OpenAPI schema
days.lab_task: Organise endpoints with tags, add summaries, descriptions and error responses, hide an internal endpoint, export the OpenAPI document and generate a Python client from it.
checks: Every endpoint has a summary and error responses
Internal endpoint absent from the schema

days.topic: Dependency Injection with Depends
subtopics: Common uses: database sessions, users and settings
days.lab_task: Write dependencies for pagination parameters, a database session with clean-up, the current user and a feature flag, share them across routers and override one in a test.
checks: Three endpoints share one pagination dependency
Test replaces the current user dependency

days.topic: Databases with SQLAlchemy and SQLModel
subtopics: Creating, reading, updating and deleting rows
Separating database models from API models
days.lab_task: Store books and authors in PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy 2.0 models, use a session per request, load related authors and keep database and API models separate.
checks: API models differ from database models where needed

days.topic: Migrations with Alembic
subtopics: Setting up Alembic with SQLAlchemy models
days.lab_task: Set up Alembic, autogenerate the first migration, add and rename columns with reviewed migrations, write a data migration and practise downgrading.
checks: Database returns to the previous schema

days.topic: CRUD APIs with Routers
days.lab_task: Build books, authors and loans routers with full CRUD, partial updates with PATCH, service functions for business rules and a feature-based folder layout.
checks: Business rule blocks lending an unavailable book
Each feature has its router, models and services

days.topic: Async Endpoints and When to Use Them
subtopics: Choosing sync or async per endpoint
days.lab_task: Compare sync and async versions of an endpoint that calls two slow services, find a blocking call inside async code, fix it and measure throughput under load.
checks: Latency close to the slower call
Blocking call identified and moved off the event loop

days.topic: Authentication with OAuth2 Password Flow and JWT
subtopics: Hashing passwords with pwdlib or passlib
Getting the current user from a token
days.lab_task: Add user registration and login with hashed passwords and JWTs, protect loan endpoints, reject disabled users and test protected endpoints with tokens.
checks: Authorize button works and calls succeed

days.topic: Settings and Secrets with pydantic-settings
days.lab_task: Move database URLs, secrets and feature flags into typed settings, fail fast on missing values, load per-environment files and override settings in tests.
checks: App refuses to start with a clear error
Each environment loads its own values

days.topic: File Uploads and Form Data
subtopics: Saving files to disk or object storage
Streaming downloads with FileResponse and StreamingResponse
days.lab_task: Add book cover uploads with type and size checks, store files in object storage, return covers through a download endpoint and stream a CSV export of the catalogue.
checks: File stored and linked to the book

days.topic: Background Tasks and Simple Scheduling
subtopics: Lifespan events for start-up and shutdown
Avoiding duplicate schedules with several workers
When to move to a task queue
days.lab_task: Send loan confirmation emails as background tasks, schedule a daily overdue check with APScheduler started in the lifespan, and explain what breaks with several workers.
days.deliverable: Background work with notes on limits
checks: Response returns before the email is sent
Overdue check runs at the set time
Duplicate schedule problem shown and a fix proposed
objectives: Know when to use a queue

days.topic: Middleware, CORS and Request Logging
days.lab_task: Add CORS for a web client, request ID and timing middleware, structured request logs without secrets, compression and trusted host checks.
checks: Allowed origin works and others are blocked
Each request logged with ID and duration
No tokens or passwords in logs

days.topic: Testing FastAPI with pytest and TestClient
subtopics: pytest fixtures for the app and database
days.lab_task: Write tests for every endpoint with fixtures for a test database, override the current user, test validation and error responses and reach 80 percent coverage.
checks: Dependency overrides switch users per test

days.topic: Calling Other APIs with HTTPX
subtopics: Wrapping an external API in a client class
days.lab_task: Build a client for a public book data API with a shared async client, timeouts, retries with tenacity and error handling, use it to enrich books and mock it in tests.
checks: Client retries and then returns a clear error

days.topic: Pagination, Filtering and Sorting
subtopics: Search with ILIKE or full-text search
days.lab_task: Add cursor pagination, filters by genre and year, safe sorting and title search to the books list, return next links and check query performance.
days.deliverable: List endpoints with pagination and filters
checks: Pages have no duplicates or gaps

days.topic: Running FastAPI in Docker with Uvicorn
subtopics: Uvicorn workers and the fastapi run command
days.lab_task: Containerise the API with a multi-stage build, run it with PostgreSQL in Docker Compose, apply migrations before start, add a health check and stop it gracefully.
checks: Image runs as a non-root user
API and database healthy with one command

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Library Management API
days.lab_task: Complete a library API with books, authors, members and loans, validation, JWT authentication, uploads, pagination, background emails, tests and Docker Compose, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, API docs and demo recording
checks: All features work from the docs page
docker compose up runs the full service
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one project

intermediate.summary: For developers who already build FastAPI services. Covers project layout for larger services, Pydantic v2 validators and serializers, async SQLAlchemy 2.0, repository and service layers, authorisation with scopes and roles, OAuth2 and OpenID Connect providers, WebSockets and server-sent events, task queues, Redis caching, rate limiting and API keys, error standards, versioning, integration testing, observability, performance, the OWASP API Top 10, serving ML models, GraphQL with Strawberry and CI/CD.
prerequisites: Has built a FastAPI service with a database and authentication
Comfortable with Python type hints and async/await
outcomes: Structure FastAPI services for teams and growth
Secure APIs with roles, scopes, identity providers and limits
Add real-time, background, caching and ML features
Test, observe, tune and deliver services through CI/CD

days.topic: Project Layout for Larger FastAPI Services
subtopics: Separating API, domain and infrastructure code
Lifespan for start-up and shutdown resources
days.lab_task: Restructure a growing service into feature packages with an application factory and lifespan-managed resources, enforce import rules and turn it into a service template.
checks: Lint fails when the domain imports FastAPI
New service generated and running in minutes
Database pool opened and closed in the lifespan

days.topic: Advanced Pydantic v2: Validators, Serializers and Custom Types
days.lab_task: Model an order API with discriminated unions for payment types, cross-field validators, reusable annotated types, computed totals and custom serialisation for money values.
checks: Discriminated union picks the right model
Validator rejects the order with a clear message
Amounts returned in the agreed format

days.topic: Async SQLAlchemy 2.0 and Session Management
subtopics: Eager loading to avoid lazy-load errors
days.lab_task: Move the service to async SQLAlchemy with asyncpg, load relations eagerly, wrap order placement in a transaction with a savepoint and tune the pool under load.
days.deliverable: Async data layer with load results
checks: No lazy-load errors in async code
Partial failure undone while the order continues
No pool timeouts at the target load

days.topic: Repository and Service Layers with Dependency Overrides
subtopics: Why separate data access from endpoints
days.lab_task: Introduce repositories, services and a unit of work for orders, wire them with Depends, test services with fake repositories and map domain errors to HTTP codes.
checks: Service tests use fake repositories and no database
Unit of work commits all changes together

days.topic: Authorisation: Scopes, Roles and Row-Level Rules
days.lab_task: Add scopes for read and write access, roles for customers, staff and admins, row-level rules so customers see only their orders, and a full permission test matrix.
checks: Every role and endpoint combination tested

days.topic: OAuth2 and OpenID Connect with External Identity Providers
subtopics: Identity providers: Keycloak, Auth0 and Microsoft Entra ID
Moving from local users to an identity provider
days.lab_task: Protect the API with tokens from Keycloak, validate signatures with JWKS, map claims to roles, sign in from Swagger UI and call another service with client credentials.
checks: Use a token for another audience
Client credentials token used for the outgoing call

days.topic: WebSockets and Server-Sent Events in FastAPI
days.lab_task: Add live order status over WebSockets with per-customer rooms, a server-sent events feed for staff, broadcasting across two workers with Redis and tests for both.
checks: Updates reach clients on both workers
WebSocket connection closed with a policy error

days.topic: Task Queues with FastAPI: Celery, ARQ and Dramatiq
days.lab_task: Move report generation and email sending to a task queue, return a task ID and status endpoint, make tasks idempotent with retries and schedule a nightly job.
checks: API returns a task ID and the status endpoint shows progress
Task retries and records the failure
Retried tasks produce no duplicate emails

days.topic: Caching with Redis in FastAPI
subtopics: What to cache in an API
days.lab_task: Cache the product catalogue and an expensive pricing call in Redis, invalidate on updates, support ETags, protect against stampedes and measure latency and hit rates.

days.topic: Rate Limiting and API Keys
subtopics: Limits per user, key and IP
days.lab_task: Add per-user and per-key rate limits with Redis, issue hashed API keys to partners with rotation, return limit headers and track usage per key.
days.deliverable: Rate limiting and partner key system
checks: Old key stops working after the grace period
Calls per key reported per day

days.topic: Error Handling Standards and Problem Details
days.lab_task: Standardise every error as problem details with stable error codes, format validation errors consistently, log errors with request context and document the error catalogue.
checks: Response follows the problem details format

days.topic: API Versioning and Evolving OpenAPI Schemas
subtopics: URL and header versioning in FastAPI
days.lab_task: Release a v2 of the orders endpoints alongside v1, deprecate a field with warnings, generate clients per version and fail CI when a breaking change reaches v1.
checks: v1 and v2 return their own contracts
CI fails on the breaking change
Deprecation shown in the schema and headers

days.topic: Integration Testing with Testcontainers and Async Tests
subtopics: Async tests with pytest-asyncio and HTTPX
days.lab_task: Write async integration tests against PostgreSQL and Redis containers with factories, mocked payment calls and rollback per test, and run them in parallel in CI.
checks: Tests pass against real PostgreSQL and Redis
No shared-state failures across ten runs

days.topic: Observability with Structured Logs, Metrics and OpenTelemetry
subtopics: Tracing SQLAlchemy, Redis and HTTPX calls
days.lab_task: Instrument the service with OpenTelemetry, trace a request through the database, Redis and an external API, expose Prometheus metrics and alert on error rate.
checks: One trace shows API, database, cache and HTTP spans
Alert triggers on a raised error rate

days.topic: Performance: Profiling, Uvicorn Workers and Gunicorn
subtopics: Uvicorn workers and Gunicorn with Uvicorn workers
days.lab_task: Load test the slowest endpoint, profile it, cut serialisation and query cost, tune the number of workers and record before and after results.
checks: Hot spots identified in the profile
Throughput measured for three worker counts
p95 latency within the budget after changes

days.topic: Securing FastAPI Services Against the OWASP API Top 10
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted issues: an object-level authorisation gap, excessive fields in responses, an SSRF in an import endpoint and unlimited page sizes, then fuzz the API with Schemathesis.
checks: Users cannot read other users' records

days.topic: Serving ML Models with FastAPI
subtopics: Input and output schemas for predictions
days.lab_task: Serve a trained model with typed prediction endpoints, load it in the lifespan, add batch predictions, run inference in a worker pool, version models and log prediction metrics.
days.deliverable: Model serving API with load results
checks: Valid inputs return predictions with model version
Invalid features rejected by the schema

days.topic: GraphQL with Strawberry on FastAPI
subtopics: Mounting a GraphQL router in FastAPI
days.lab_task: Add a GraphQL endpoint for the order dashboard with Strawberry, batch database access with DataLoaders, authenticate through context and limit query depth.
checks: Nested query runs a fixed small number of database queries
Unauthenticated queries for private data refused

days.topic: CI/CD and Container Deployment for FastAPI
subtopics: Pipeline stages: lint, type check, test and build
days.lab_task: Build a GitHub Actions pipeline that lints, type-checks and tests the service, builds and scans the image, deploys to staging with migrations, runs smoke tests and rolls back once.
checks: All stages pass on a pull request

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Multi-Tenant Booking API
days.lab_task: Build a booking API with tenants, roles, identity provider sign-in, real-time availability, queued notifications, caching, rate limits, versioned docs, tests, tracing and CI/CD, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, API docs, reports and presentation
checks: Bookings flow end to end with live availability
Tests, security scans and performance results meet targets
Layering, data and security choices explained
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one service

advanced.summary: For senior Python API engineers and technical leads. Covers ASGI internals, microservice boundaries, event-driven services with Kafka and RabbitMQ, high-throughput concurrency and backpressure, resilient service calls, multi-tenant platforms, gateways and service mesh, Kubernetes, serverless FastAPI, LLM APIs, mTLS and supply chain security, contract testing and governance, data-intensive streaming APIs, database scaling, performance engineering, internal libraries, migrations from Flask and DRF, zero-downtime releases and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years building production Python APIs
Strong async Python, SQLAlchemy and FastAPI skills
Has run services in containers in production
outcomes: Engineer throughput, resilience and security at scale
Govern APIs and migrations across teams

days.topic: ASGI Internals: Starlette, Uvicorn and the Event Loop
subtopics: The ASGI specification: scope, receive and send
The asyncio event loop and uvloop
days.lab_task: Write a raw ASGI app and middleware, trace a FastAPI request through Uvicorn and Starlette in the debugger, and show how sync endpoints use the thread pool.
checks: Middleware adds timing without Starlette helpers
Each layer from server to endpoint identified
Sync endpoint queueing shown and explained

days.topic: Microservices with FastAPI: Boundaries and Communication
subtopics: Synchronous calls with HTTPX and gRPC
When a modular monolith is better
days.lab_task: Split an order monolith into order, payment and stock services with owned data, coordinate checkout with a saga and compare latency and complexity with the monolith.
checks: No service reads another service's database

days.topic: Event-Driven FastAPI with Kafka and RabbitMQ
subtopics: Schema evolution with JSON Schema or Avro
days.lab_task: Publish order events through an outbox to Kafka, consume them idempotently in two services, route failures to a dead letter queue and evolve an event schema safely.
days.deliverable: Event-driven services with an event catalogue
checks: Message lands in the dead letter queue
Old and new consumers keep working

days.topic: High-Throughput APIs: Concurrency Limits, Pools and Backpressure
subtopics: Connection pools for databases and HTTP
days.lab_task: Find the saturation point of an API that calls a database and two services, add concurrency limits, pool sizing and load shedding, and show stable latency at overload.
days.deliverable: Capacity model and load test results
checks: No pool waits at the target load

days.topic: Resilient Service Calls in FastAPI: Timeouts, Retries and Circuit Breakers
subtopics: Retries with jitter and retry budgets
days.lab_task: Inject latency and errors into a dependency, add timeouts, retry budgets, a circuit breaker, bulkheads and idempotency keys, and show the API degrades gracefully.
checks: Calls fail fast while the dependency is down

days.topic: Multi-Tenant Architecture for FastAPI Platforms
subtopics: Tenant resolution from tokens or domains
days.lab_task: Make a platform multi-tenant with tenant context from tokens, row-level security in PostgreSQL, per-tenant rate limits and tenant-aware cache keys, and prove isolation.
checks: No cross-tenant data in any endpoint
Other tenants unaffected during a flood

days.topic: API Gateways and Service Mesh for FastAPI Services
subtopics: Rate limiting and quotas at the edge
Service mesh basics with Istio or Linkerd
days.lab_task: Put services behind a gateway with token checks and quotas, enable mTLS through a mesh, split traffic for a canary and decide which concerns stay in FastAPI.
days.deliverable: Gateway and mesh configuration with a responsibilities map
checks: Requests without valid tokens stopped at the edge
Canary receives a share of traffic and is promoted

days.topic: FastAPI on Kubernetes: Probes, Autoscaling and Graceful Shutdown
days.lab_task: Deploy the service to Kubernetes with probes, graceful shutdown, tuned workers and resources, migration jobs and autoscaling, and prove a rollout drops no requests.
checks: No failed requests during the rollout
Pods scale on the custom metric
Migration job completes before new pods take traffic

days.topic: Serverless FastAPI on AWS Lambda and Azure Functions
days.lab_task: Run part of the API on AWS Lambda with Mangum behind API Gateway, reduce cold starts, manage database connections and compare cost with containers at three traffic levels.
checks: Cold start time lower after packaging changes
Connection count stays stable under load
Monthly cost compared at three traffic levels

days.topic: LLM and AI APIs with FastAPI: Streaming, Tools and Cost Controls
subtopics: Retrieval with pgvector or a vector database
Token budgets and rate limits per user
days.lab_task: Build an assistant endpoint that streams answers, calls tools to read order data, grounds answers in documents with pgvector, enforces token budgets and logs cost per user.
checks: Assistant returns the user's real order status

days.topic: Advanced Security: mTLS, Secrets and Supply Chain
subtopics: Secrets from a vault at runtime
days.lab_task: Threat model the platform, require mTLS for a partner endpoint, load secrets from Vault, sign images and produce SBOMs, and pin dependencies with hashes.
days.deliverable: Threat model and hardened platform configuration
checks: Partner calls without a valid certificate refused
SBOM lists every package with versions

days.topic: Contract Testing and API Governance
subtopics: API design guidelines for many teams
days.lab_task: Write API guidelines as Spectral rules, add Pact contracts between two services, fuzz endpoints with Schemathesis and block breaking changes in CI.
checks: Spectral rules pass for all services

days.topic: Data-Intensive APIs: Streaming Responses and Large Uploads
days.lab_task: Stream a ten-million-row export as NDJSON with a server-side cursor, accept resumable multi-gigabyte uploads directly to object storage and process them in the background with progress.
checks: Memory stays flat during the export
Interrupted upload resumes from the last part
Processing progress visible to the client

days.topic: Database Scaling for FastAPI: Read Replicas, Pooling and Sharding
days.lab_task: Route reads to replicas with read-after-write consistency, put PgBouncer in front of PostgreSQL for async connections, partition the orders table and find the new capacity limit.
days.deliverable: Data tier scaling configuration and results
checks: Reads go to replicas except after the user's own writes
No connection errors with many pods
Recent order queries scan only recent partitions

days.topic: Performance Engineering: Profiling with py-spy and Load Testing
days.lab_task: Profile a production-like service under load, fix CPU and memory hot spots, compare Python versions, set budgets and add a performance regression check to CI.
checks: CPU and memory hot spots identified
Peak memory lower after the fix
CI fails when latency exceeds the budget

days.topic: Building Reusable Internal Libraries and Templates
subtopics: When to share code between services
Internal packages for auth, logging and clients
days.lab_task: Extract auth, logging and error handling into internal packages, build a service template with copier, publish packages and update three services with Renovate.
checks: New service from the template passes all checks
New version released with a changelog
Three services updated by Renovate pull requests

days.topic: Migrating from Flask or Django REST Framework to FastAPI
subtopics: Reasons to migrate and reasons not to
Mapping Flask and DRF concepts to FastAPI
Running old and new side by side
Moving endpoints one at a time behind a proxy
days.lab_task: Migrate five endpoints from a Flask or DRF service to FastAPI behind a proxy, keep tokens compatible, prove response parity with tests and plan the rest of the migration.
days.deliverable: Partly migrated service and migration plan
checks: Old and new endpoints work for clients
Plan lists endpoints, risks and order

days.topic: Zero-Downtime Releases and Database Migrations
days.lab_task: Restructure a heavily used column with expand and contract, backfill in batches during traffic, release behind a flag with a canary and roll back once.
days.deliverable: Release plan, migrations and release record
checks: Backfill completes without a latency spike
Canary users get the new version first
Rollback restores old behaviour without data loss

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production FastAPI Incidents
subtopics: Event loop blocking and latency spikes
days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: a blocked event loop, worker memory growth, pool exhaustion and a cascading dependency failure, restore service and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Each cause backed by profiles, traces or metrics
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Event-Driven API Platform on FastAPI
days.lab_task: Build an event-driven platform with three FastAPI services, an outbox, idempotent consumers, multi-tenancy, resilience patterns, contract tests, an AI endpoint, Kubernetes deployment and full tracing, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, runbooks and architecture defence
checks: Platform recovers from broker and service failures
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
